architectureA.name: Vishvarupa Phone

architectureB.name: Vishvarupa Phone Sovereign Supreme
architectureB.purpose: The subsequent sovereign phone-native software factory: one new monorepo physically hosted in Android internal shared storage, built and operated locally through Termux scripts, independent of GitHub, cloud services, EDEN, Cali, and the connected estate at runtime.
architectureB.repository: New monorepo to be created in Android internal storage in the next phase; do not create it during the current mission
architectureB.sourceAuthority: Local Git repository in Android internal storage
architectureB.inference: Local Ollama/model runtime only after phone hardware and Android constraints are benchmarked; no external model/cloud dependency
architectureB.firstUseCase: MetaForge generates scripts; operator feeds approved scripts into Termux; local command-to-proof build creates installable software packages; export completed artifacts and keep the phone workspace clean
independenceConstraints: No network requirement for core build/test/package loop

boundaryRules: Do not merge Architecture A and Architecture B into one deployment or one repository.
Architecture A may document Architecture B as a future separate product line, but must not claim its local monorepo exists.
Architecture B will receive a new monorepo only when the next mission begins.

Existing estate names may be used as provenance or translated into standalone local components, but runtime dependencies are forbidden in Architecture B unless the Architect explicitly changes the independence contract.
The current mission continues on Architecture A until its deliverables and proof are complete.
